utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Wann bringst du das vorbei? Ich kann nachher kurz helfen.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Heute Abend, wenn es passt. Danke, das hilft mir sehr.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alles klar, dann bis heute Abend. Sag kurz Bescheid, wenn du da bist.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know the schedule and where the parts are going first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the schedule and exactly where the parts are going?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can confirm it once I know the exact schedule and the delivery spot for the parts.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed the update, what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Just bring yourself and maybe a screwdriver if you’ve got one, Noah. I always forget the little stuff, but I think that’ll cover it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can do that. I’ll grab a screwdriver and head over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help get it moving, yes. Let’s see what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check what still needs fixing and keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but I’m here now. What’s left to fix on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: A few things, mostly. I’ve got extra tools here, so if you want to start on the loose siding and the wobbly gate, we can knock those out first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Let’s start with the siding, then I can take the gate after that.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, let’s keep it simple and get the repair drive mapped out before anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll start pulling people together and get the repair drive organized before anything else shifts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Once you’ve got the people in hand, bring me the list and we’ll keep the schedule tight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mostly the loose railing on the porch, the broken fence panel by the side yard, and a few doors that stick. I can point them out when people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help make sure everyone knows about it. I’ll spread the word and see who’s available to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll keep an ear out and make sure the right people hear about it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m on it, Rosa. I’ll help keep the repair drive moving and make sure we follow through on what we promised.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Mara. Let’s keep that momentum and check in after the first round so we can clear any blockers quickly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely. I’ll check back after the first round and help clear anything that’s blocking us.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve still got a few gloves and a spool of wire if we need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring the gloves over, and we can keep the wire handy in case we need a quick fix.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re still looking for a few more hands for the repair drive. If you’re free, you should swing by; they could use all the help they can get.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I might be able to help for a bit. I’ll swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: How should I help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help sort and hand out the donated parts? I’m trying to keep the drive moving around school pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I can do that. I’ll sort them and hand them out around pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help with that. What exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: The porch light keeps flickering, and the gate hinge is loose.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can take a look at both.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m on it. I’ll mention the repair drive to folks again.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik. I’ll remind a few more folks too so we get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep spreading the word too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I think I missed the latest change, what’s the status?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still sorting out the details, but the drive is moving forward.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — just let me know what changed when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that repair drive if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey. I’ve got the tools covered, but I may take you up on that if anything gives me trouble.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Appreciate it. I’ll be around if you need a second pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Opal. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’ll make sure we keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll keep an eye on the list and help make sure the repairs stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal. I’ll keep you posted as the list moves, and we’ll make sure nothing slips through the cracks.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we should make a clear pickup plan first, so nothing gets dropped or delayed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I can start a pickup list and let everyone know the plan so nothing slips through.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, and we should set a cutoff time too so no one is left waiting around.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still on. I just want to confirm the details before I say it’s definite.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just tell me once the details are settled.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can do that first thing in the morning, Dane. Just tell me where you want me to start, and I’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, I’ll head over early and start at the back gate.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll be there early, and I’ll start at the back gate with you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there was a drive on for the repairs, but I’m only getting bits and pieces. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly organized now: they’ve got the repair drive underway, and I’m hearing we still need a few more supplies before they can wrap up the next phase.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — sounds like they’re close, but still short on supplies. Do you know what they need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I may have missed a detail, but I’m here to help if you remind me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Just point me at what needs fixing and I’ll get to it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after drop-off, but I need to keep the school run on track first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem, I can take the repair drive after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that helps a lot. I’ll handle drop-off, and you can take care of the repair drive after.
